name: Bookmarks
description: Save links with projects, tags and notes. Pin the ones you use most; filter by project or tag.

create.description: Save a link. Takes url (with optional title), or text such as "Rust book doc.rust-lang.org/book #rust": the address is the link, #words are tags, other words the title. Optional tags, project, note, pinned. An address already saved returns that bookmark.

update.description: Change a bookmark's url, title, project, tags, note or pinned.

pin.description: Pin or unpin a bookmark (pinned: true/false); without pinned it flips.

visit.description: Count a visit and remember when.

restore.description: Bring a bookmark back from trash.

tag_names.sql: WITH RECURSIVE s(tag, rest) AS (SELECT '', tags || ', ' FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND tags IS NOT NULL AND tags <> '' UNION ALL SELECT trim(substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ', ') - 1)), substr(rest, instr(rest, ', ') + 2) FROM s WHERE rest <> '') SELECT tag AS value, COUNT(*) AS count FROM s WHERE tag <> '' GROUP BY tag ORDER BY count DESC, tag LIMIT 60

focus_suggestions.sql: WITH RECURSIVE s(tag, rest) AS (SELECT '', tags || ', ' FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND tags IS NOT NULL AND tags <> '' UNION ALL SELECT trim(substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ', ') - 1)), substr(rest, instr(rest, ', ') + 2) FROM s WHERE rest <> ''), names(value) AS (SELECT project FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND project IS NOT NULL AND project <> '' UNION ALL SELECT tag FROM s WHERE tag <> '') SELECT value, COUNT(*) AS count FROM names GROUP BY value ORDER BY count DESC, value LIMIT 30

THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END END AS host, CASE WHEN instr(CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END, 1, instr(CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END, '/') - 1) ELSE CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END END || COALESCE(' · ' || NULLIF(trim(substr(replace(note, char(10), ' '), 1, 100)), ''), '') AS subtitle, project, tags, CASE WHEN tags IS NOT NULL AND tags <> '' THEN '#' || replace(tags, ', ', ' #') END AS tags_label, note, COALESCE(visits, 0) AS visits, CASE WHEN COALESCE(visits, 0) = 0 THEN NULL WHEN visits = 1 THEN '1 visit' ELSE visits || ' visits' END AS visits_label, pinned, CASE WHEN created_at IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN date((created_at + ?5) / 1000, 'unixepoch') = ?6 THEN strftime('%H:%M', (created_at + ?5) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN date((created_at + ?5) / 1000, 'unixepoch') = date(?6, '-1 day') THEN 'Yesterday ' || strftime('%H:%M', (created_at + ?5) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN date((created_at + ?5) / 1000, 'unixepoch') > date(?6, '-7 day') THEN CASE strftime('%w', (created_at + ?5) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN '0' THEN 'Sun' WHEN '1' THEN 'Mon' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tue' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wed' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thu' WHEN '5' THEN 'Fri' ELSE 'Sat' END || ' ' || strftime('%H:%M', (created_at + ?5) / 1000, 'unixepoch') ELSE CAST(strftime('%d', (created_at + ?5) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) || ' ' || substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', (CAST(strftime('%m', (created_at + ?5) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 + 1, 3) || CASE WHEN substr(date((created_at + ?5) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) <> substr(?6, 1, 4) THEN ' ' || substr(date((created_at + ?5) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) ELSE '' END END AS added, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND (?1 IS NULL OR ?1 = '' OR title LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR url LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR tags LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR note LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR project LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%') AND (?2 IS NULL OR ?2 = '' OR project = ?2) AND (?3 IS NULL OR ?3 = '' OR instr(', ' || COALESCE(tags, '') || ', ', ', ' || ?3 || ', ') > 0) AND pinned = 1) = 0 THEN NULL WHEN pinned = 1 THEN 'Pinned' ELSE 'Bookmarks' END AS section FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND (?1 IS NULL OR ?1 = '' OR title LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR url LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR tags LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR note LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR project LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%') AND (?2 IS NULL OR ?2 = '' OR project = ?2) AND (?3 IS NULL OR ?3 = '' OR instr(', ' || COALESCE(tags, '') || ', ', ', ' || ?3 || ', ') > 0) ORDER BY pinned DESC, CASE ?4 WHEN 'visits' THEN -COALESCE(visits, 0) WHEN 'opened' THEN -COALESCE(visited_at, 0) ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN ?4 = 'title' THEN lower(title) END, COALESCE(created_at, 0) DESC, id DESC LIMIT 500

projects.sql: SELECT '' AS project, 'All' AS label, COUNT(*) AS count, (?1 IS NULL OR ?1 = '') AS selected, 0 AS k FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND project IS NOT NULL AND project <> '') UNION ALL SELECT project, project, COUNT(*), project = ?1, 1 FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND project IS NOT NULL AND project <> '' GROUP BY project ORDER BY k, project

tags.sql: WITH RECURSIVE s(tag, rest) AS (SELECT '', tags || ', ' FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND tags IS NOT NULL AND tags <> '' AND (?1 IS NULL OR ?1 = '' OR project = ?1) UNION ALL SELECT substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ', ') - 1), substr(rest, instr(rest, ', ') + 2) FROM s WHERE rest <> '') SELECT tag, '#' || tag AS label, COUNT(*) AS count, tag = ?2 AS selected, CASE WHEN tag = ?2 THEN '' ELSE tag END AS next FROM s WHERE tag <> '' GROUP BY tag ORDER BY tag = ?2 DESC, count DESC, tag LIMIT 40

project_names.sql: SELECT DISTINCT project FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND project IS NOT NULL AND project <> '' ORDER BY project

summary.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) || CASE COUNT(*) WHEN 1 THEN ' link' ELSE ' links' END || CASE WHEN SUM(pinned = 1) > 0 THEN ' · ' || SUM(pinned = 1) || ' pinned' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(project, '')) > 0 THEN ' · ' || COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(project, '')) || CASE COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(project, '')) WHEN 1 THEN ' project' ELSE ' projects' END ELSE '' END AS label FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL
